compiled_state.description:
## Summary

Follow-up split from injurious-pugnacious-azurevase (c0f6-0fc9-fe48-41bc), the class-fix
for repo/config-root-derived-from-the-store-path. That ticket landed the behavior-preserving
`str(tracker)` subset (composer.py / composer_edit.py) and the `str()` half of the AST guard.
This ticket covers the DESIGN-JUDGMENT `realpath()`/`abspath()` subset it deliberately deferred,
plus feisty-intense-mandrill's `.canonical` guard blind spot.

## The approved principle (operator-decided; this principle GOVERNS site bucketing)

On a RELOCATED store (store outside the code checkout — the deployed MCP topology: code at
`/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`, store at `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets`), a site that composes a
root as `dirname(realpath/abspath(tracker))` wants ONE of two roots. The DISCRIMINATOR is
whether the site reads `compose_config()`:

1. Anything that READS `compose_config()` (directly, or via `config.tickets_branch()` /
   `config.tickets_remote()` / `config.compose_config()`) resolves the CODE repo root via the
   sanctioned resolver `config.repo_root_or_none()`. `rebar.toml` lives in the checkout, so
   reading it from the store's parent is the bug. (behavior-CHANGING on a relocated store →
   each proven by a RED→GREEN oracle)
2. Git operations on the store's OWN repo — git history/attribution/identity keyed on
   `git -C <tracker>`, or a store-path hint string — that DO NOT read `compose_config()` keep
   the STORE root, routed through ONE shared seam `rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker)`.
   (behavior-PRESERVING: the seam returns exactly `dirname(realpath(tracker))`)

Divergence is prevented BY CONSTRUCTION: the code root goes through
`config.repo_root_or_none()`; the store root goes through the single seam
`rebar._proc.store_repo_root()` (marked `# repo-root-seam:`); and the AC#3 guard fails CI on any
other direct spelling.

## Candidate sites (disposition by the compose_config() discriminator)

CODE ROOT (reads compose_config; via `config.repo_root_or_none()`; behavior-changing → RED→GREEN):
- src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:238 — `_sync_disabled(...)` -> `compose_config(root).sync.pull`.
- src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:249 — `tickets_branch(...)` -> `tickets.branch`.
- src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:374 — `_load_scratch` -> `compose_config(root).scratch.base_dir`.
- src/rebar/_store/freshness.py:80 — `_remote_ref` -> `tickets_remote/tickets_branch` (the store's
  remote-tracking ref for the staleness probe; realpath()-wrapped member of this class).
- src/rebar/_commands/fsck_tracker_health.py — `_branch_mismatch` FALLBACK (:83),
  `_tracker_sync_status` (:204), `_configured_remote_ref` (:374) -> `tickets_branch/tickets_remote`.
  (`_branch_mismatch` still prefers the code `repo_root` fsck threads; only its fallback changed.)

STORE ROOT (NO compose_config read; via the shared seam `rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker)`;
behavior-preserving — `git -C <tracker>` on the store's OWN repo / attribution / a path hint):
- src/rebar/_proc.py — `detached_child_cwd` (uses the seam directly; stdlib-only leaf home).
- src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py:524, compact_rebuild.py:139 — `_build_authorship_ledger`
  repo_root (git history/signing of the store's own events; no compose_config).
- src/rebar/_commands/compact_plan.py:212 — `_seam.attribution_fields` repo_root (git author_email
  / identity of the store's own repo; no compose_config).
- src/rebar/_commands/fsck.py:253 — `repo_guess`, a path-hint STRING joined to `.tickets-tracker`
  for a dir-mismatch warning (no compose_config).

ALREADY SANCTIONED — out of this ticket's realpath/abspath scope (do NOT re-triage):
- src/rebar/_store/sync.py:305/307 — `tickets_branch/tickets_remote(dirname(str(tracker)))`, the
  `str()` variant, already carrying a `# repo-root-ok:` sanction (line 306) landed by the parent
  ticket c0f6-0fc9. Not a realpath()/abspath() member. Left untouched (also avoids collision with
  concurrent ticket baldish-regainable-steed).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC#1 — Every realpath()/abspath() config-read site (the CODE-ROOT list above:
  reads.py:238/:249/:374, freshness.py:80, fsck_tracker_health.py `_branch_mismatch` fallback /
  `_tracker_sync_status` / `_configured_remote_ref`) resolves `cfg_root` from the CODE repo via
  `config.repo_root_or_none()` (or, where fsck already threads it, an explicit `repo_root`).
  VERIFY: `grep -rn 'dirname' src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py src/rebar/_store/freshness.py
  src/rebar/_commands/fsck_tracker_health.py` shows none of these sites wraps `tracker` in
  `dirname(realpath/abspath(...))` for the config root any more. Each is behavior-changing on a
  relocated store, so each is proven by a RED→GREEN oracle in
  `tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py` (the reads.py, freshness, `_tracker_sync_status`,
  `_configured_remote_ref`, and `_branch_mismatch`-fallback cases).
- [x] AC#2 — Every git/attribution store-repo site that does NOT read compose_config (the
  STORE-ROOT list above: _proc.py `detached_child_cwd`, compact_txn/rebuild `_build_authorship_ledger`,
  compact_plan `attribution_fields`, fsck.py `repo_guess`) is routed through the single shared seam
  `rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker)` (behavior-preserving: the seam returns exactly what these
  sites computed before), and the seam carries the `# repo-root-seam:` marker. VERIFY:
  `grep -rn 'store_repo_root' src/rebar` shows every store-repo site calls the seam;
  `python scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` is green. sync.py:305/307 is already sanctioned —
  no action. No compose_config read → no relocated-store behavior change → no new oracle needed
  (behavior-preservation covered by the existing store-command tests plus the guard).
- [x] AC#3 — Extend `scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` to also flag the
  realpath()/abspath()-wrapped store argument AND `dirname(StorePaths(tracker).canonical)`
  (feisty-intense-mandrill's blind spot), so the guard is airtight for the whole class: the ONLY
  exempt spellings are the shared seam (`# repo-root-seam:`) and the already-sanctioned store-repo
  sites (`# repo-root-ok:`). Proven by the guard self-test
  (`tests/unit/test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard.py`) — the old "realpath/abspath NOT unwrapped"
  case is inverted, and `.canonical`/str-wrapped/seam-marker/single-seam cases are added.

## Testing

- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard.py tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py -q` — guard flags the realpath/abspath/.canonical variants; each config-read behavior change has a RED→GREEN oracle.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` — green on the fixed tree with all legitimate store-repo sites routed through the seam or sanctioned.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint && make typecheck` — no regressions.
